method: Camera-ray visibility from rendered geometry alpha, alpha<128 inside the identical projected near facade rectangle: source X=3.25, length -7..7, world up -0.95..2.8. Includes occlusion by the entire actual bridge. This is visible open silhouette above water, not a horizontal ray test or only analytic ellipse area. Antialiased perimeter pixels can contribute less than one pixel of boundary error.
visual_assessment: Paired raised-water previews show a broader continuous curved opening and narrower piers in V3, with the same upper deck and parapets. Controlled geometry improvement; no independent Unity water-gate score or full-scene acceptance claimed.
